roleTitle: Inizio Engage Growth Enablement and Launch Specialist

job.rawJd: We are seeking a Growth Enablement and Launch Specialist provide Client Solutions with specialized, professional opportunity development support while continuing to manage implementation of new engagements. Why You'll Love Working Here: We believe great people deserve great support at work and beyond. That's why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially. Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact. Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave. Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most. Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions. Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support. A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference. We are also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience: Best Place to Work in BioPharma in 2022, 2023, and 2025; Certified Great Place to Work in 2021, 2023, 2025, and 2026. Opportunity Development 50%: Apply strong knowledge of the Engage business and client context to draft initial RFP responses and proposals. Proactively solicit information from Engage SMEs, where needed, to validate and build out gaps. Manage the planning and development of proposals. Actively participate in client-facing fact-finding meetings to capture proposal implications and actions. Maintain the proposal repository for your dedicated Specialty Area and lead the collection of cost, scheduling, and other elements from functional departments. Develop knowledge of the broader Engage service portfolio and flex to provide capacity when needed. Implementation Support 50%: Support Operations Leads through execution of new program stand-up. Develop a project plan and provide strong project management; proactively plan, execute, and monitor milestones to achieve objectives within scope, time, and budget. Identify and assign appropriate internal and external stakeholders to complete necessary tasks. Function as liaison to Operations Leads and client PMO; develop the necessary repository of client documents and ensure seamless transition to the Solutions Team post-implementation. Requirements: Deep knowledge of the life sciences industry and/or one or more of the Engage specialty areas. Excellent written communication and presentation skills. Proficient with creating professional sales materials, including slide design, copywriting, and storytelling. Familiarity with the business-to-business sales process. Strong business acumen. Five or more years of direct project-management work experience is required. A project-management qualification or equivalent is required, with PMP certification preferred. Knowledge of theoretical and practical aspects of project management. Proficiency in project-management software, tools, and techniques. Proven experience in strategic planning, risk and cost management, and time and resource management. Strong collaborator who is adaptable. Excellent planning and organizing skills. Proactive, persistent leader who drives for results. The base pay range is USD 49,000 to USD 91,000 per year. Final compensation depends on experience, skills, internal equity, and business needs.
